# Vendored third-party protocol peers

Every file in this directory is an unmodified copy of an upstream file written
by a third party (not by this project), kept together with its upstream license
file. `SHA256SUMS` lists the hash of every vendored file; `sha256sum -c
SHA256SUMS` (run in this directory) verifies them. The tests only instantiate
or import these files; any adaptation lives in `../tb_ext.v` (Verilog glue) and
`../test_ext_*.py`.

| directory | upstream (pinned commit) | license | files | used as |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `verilog-uart/` | [alexforencich/verilog-uart@1b867e5](https://github.com/alexforencich/verilog-uart/tree/1b867e53af738e4a8bc7c839ca2f1c07f40382dc) (2025-02-27) | MIT (`COPYING`) | `rtl/uart_rx.v`, `rtl/uart_tx.v` | UART receiver on pin 0, UART transmitter on pin 1 |
| `verilog-i2c/` | [alexforencich/verilog-i2c@a65be40](https://github.com/alexforencich/verilog-i2c/tree/a65be4045e898a52e791c6ee71f8f79a7cd2e129) (2025-02-27) | MIT (`COPYING`) | `rtl/i2c_slave.v`, `rtl/i2c_master.v` | I2C target (DUT controller) and I2C controller (DUT target) |
| `picorv32-spiflash/` | [YosysHQ/picorv32@ef203c2](https://github.com/YosysHQ/picorv32/tree/ef203c2b0a3fb793280f5114941416c425c5b461) (2026-09-07) | ISC (`COPYING`) | `picosoc/spiflash.v` | SPI NOR flash model (commands AB, B9, 03; modes 0/3) |
| `nandland-spi-master/` | [nandland/spi-master@1ab5819](https://github.com/nandland/spi-master/tree/1ab581969f8ea2f794072a144b55cd74e5a54f34) (2022-01-31) | MIT (`LICENSE`) | `Verilog/source/SPI_Master.v`, `Verilog/source/SPI_Master_With_Single_CS.v` | SPI controller, modes 0-3 (DUT target) |
| `nandland-spi-slave/` | [nandland/spi-slave@e12af34](https://github.com/nandland/spi-slave/tree/e12af3489df78d30dd745b00d163a3848bdcea69) (2022-01-31) | MIT (`LICENSE`) | `Verilog/source/SPI_Slave.v` | SPI target, modes 0-3 (DUT controller); known upstream defects, see `../../docs/independent-peers.md` |
| `hazard3-jtag-dtm/` | [Wren6991/Hazard3@8af9929](https://github.com/Wren6991/Hazard3/tree/8af992930f71a69b0e06c38734c1094f41a05ca0) (2026-03-12) | Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`) | `hdl/debug/dtm/hazard3_jtag_dtm.v`, `hdl/debug/dtm/hazard3_jtag_dtm_core.v`, `hdl/debug/cdc/hazard3_apb_async_bridge.v`, `hdl/debug/cdc/hazard3_sync_1bit.v`, `hdl/debug/cdc/hazard3_reset_sync.v` | JTAG TAP: IEEE 1149.1 state machine, RISC-V JTAG-DTM registers (IDCODE, DTMCS, DMI, BYPASS); Capture-IR loads the current IR, not the 1149.1 `...01` pattern |
| `cocotbext-uart/` | [alexforencich/cocotbext-uart@2f67153](https://github.com/alexforencich/cocotbext-uart/tree/2f6715397e402cd708302798bf31cef4a1a38173) (2026-08-24, version 0.1.5) | MIT (`LICENSE`) | `cocotbext/uart/{__init__,uart,version}.py` | `UartSource` (pin 1), `UartSink` (pin 0) |
| `cocotbext-i2c/` | [alexforencich/cocotbext-i2c@a1a4d5d](https://github.com/alexforencich/cocotbext-i2c/tree/a1a4d5da1cffe7b317a0ca2f3aff15e72df35bea) (2026-08-24, version 0.1.3) | MIT (`LICENSE`) | `cocotbext/i2c/{__init__,i2c_device,i2c_master,i2c_memory,version}.py` | `I2cMemory` (EEPROM-style target), `I2cMaster` |
| `cocotbext-spi/` | [schang412/cocotbext-spi@67857d0](https://github.com/schang412/cocotbext-spi/tree/67857d0c7b9ea854467b57269becb9b221d9986e) (2026-07-25) | MIT (`COPYING`) | `cocotbext/spi/{__init__,about,exceptions,spi}.py`, `cocotbext/spi/devices/generic.py` | `SpiMaster` (DUT target), `SpiSlaveLoopback` (DUT controller) |

Upstream paths are relative to the repository root at the pinned commit; the
copies are flattened into the directory shown. The Python packages are the
pure-Python sources of the respective PyPI projects at those commits; the
cocotbext packages' own test matrices name cocotb 2.0.1, the version this suite
uses. `cocotbext-spi` reports version `0.0.0` here because its version string
is generated by setuptools_scm at install time.
